submitted.rationale: Index 2 (Pb0.68Sb0.32) had the highest measured EQE, 0.093%. Its XRD matches the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore (Naples yellow) plus PbO, and this phase absorbs at 2.4 eV. The more Pb-rich index 0 dropped to 0.036%, so the optimum is likely near index 2.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE ~5e-6%. The Sb-rich region is wide-gap PbSb2O6-type (XRD at indices 8 and 14 matches it best; MEGNet gives 2.7 eV, above the photon energy).

consultations.verdict: Mostly uninformative. MEGNet puts Pb2Sb2O7 near 0 eV, which is implausible because experimentally it is the yellow pigment with a gap around 2.4-2.6 eV. PbSb2O6 comes out at 2.7 eV, above the 2.4 eV photon energy. MACE finds mp-647520 Pb2Sb2O7 near the hull (0.05 eV/atom). Index 2's XRD matches the pyrochlore plus PbO, so it is the Pb-rich absorbing phase. That weakly supports measuring it.

Supports measuring. MACE puts PbSb2O6 on the hull, so the Sb-rich region should be one stable phase, which fits the XRD at indices 8 and 14. Index 2 on the pyrochlore side gave a low EQE (0.093%), so sampling the other phase field at its centre is informative.

Weakly against. MEGNet gives litharge PbO 3.36 eV, but the measured gap is about 1.9-2.7 eV, so the prediction underweights PbO absorption at 2.4 eV. On balance it is uninformative. The measured trend (Pb-rich index 2 is about 20000x better than index 11) supports moving further Pb-rich to index 0.
